summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-08 at src/design/adp-08-service-task-catalog-reference.md. The design specifies additive SERVICE_TASK configuration semantics for legacy url and new service_id catalog reference, deterministic precedence with warning when both are present, service_id execution routing through catalog lookup with capability enforcement, explicit failure behavior for missing or invalid catalog entries, compatibility guarantees preserving EXT-01 behavior, and acceptance-mapped testability guidance.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified required design sections and full ADP-08 acceptance mapping, including additive schema semantics, deterministic precedence with warning behavior, service catalog lookup and capability enforcement rules, failure-mode behavior for invalid catalog references, and backward-compatibility constraints for EXT-01 legacy definitions.
